summary: Complete testing of Teams CRUD feature. Backend: 12/12 tests passed. Frontend: All Teams management features working correctly including Create, Edit, Delete teams, Manage team members (add/remove athletes), and Equipo dropdown in athlete registration form.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Equipo_Playwright team during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teams CRUD feature fully tested. Navigation: Login → Datos → Select Plan → Información → Equipos. Backend APIs: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/teams, POST/DELETE /api/teams/{team_id}/athletes/{athlete_id}. Frontend: TeamManager component renders correctly with create/edit/delete modals, manage members modal, and team card expansion. Athlete registration form has 'Equipo' dropdown (data-testid='athlete-team-select') that shows available teams.
